results.title: Tom Hanks' Oscar-Winning Turn in Philadelphia Remains His Finest Dramatic Performance Three Decades Later
results.description: An analysis of how Tom Hanks' role in the 1993 film Philadelphia transformed his career from comedy star to serious dramatic actor, earning him his first Academy Award and sparking crucial cultural conversations about HIV/AIDS and discrimination.

results.title: Johnny Depp's Ebenezer Box Office Drop and Global Recovery Outlook
results.description: Johnny Depp's Ebenezer suffered a 59.5% domestic box office drop in its second weekend. The film retains strong international revenue and an A- CinemaScore, signaling a potential comeback path despite stiff competition.

results.title: Bigg Boss Tamil 10: Shathiga and Mukesh Exit in Double Eviction
results.description: Bigg Boss Tamil 10 Day 77 witnessed a double eviction as Shathiga and Mukesh exited the house. Vijay Sethupathi also addressed Jason's behaviour, Dhanya's captaincy and growing trust issues among contestants
